lines.label: M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text:
Compact sewing organizer designed on a 3-cell cluster for tidy storage.

**Build created:**
- 3-cell L-shape providing separate zones
- Cell 0,0: 2-compartment bin for larger items (fabric scraps, patterns)
- Cell 0,1: 3-compartment bin for small notions (buttons, bobbins, needles)
- Cell 1,0: 2-compartment bin for thread/spools
- 2x Hook plates on exterior flats for scissors, tape measure, seam ripper

All bins are drop-in trays hanging on cell rims - no fixings needed, and mesh clearance verified.
